name: Hallowed Letter
summary: In Northshire Valley, Priestess Anetta calls young priests to Northshire Abbey. Her letter begins their study of the Holy Light.

sections.title: A Call to Faith
sections.body: Priestess Anetta’s personal mark appears on the Hallowed Letter. It reaches fledgling priests after their first trials against the kobold camps of Northshire Valley. She sees a spark of the Holy Light in each novice and urges them to enter the abbey and serve it. Dark forces still linger across Azeroth after the Third War. The priesthood gathers those who can heal, protect, and guide an empire struggling to keep order.

faq.answer: The Hallowed Letter is Priestess Anetta’s missive to newly arrived priests at Northshire Abbey. It summons them to their first class instruction.
Priestess Anetta’s insignia marks the letter. She trains and guides young human priests arriving at Northshire.

faq.q: Why is the priesthood calling for new initiates right now?
faq.answer: Azeroth remains in turmoil, and remnants of the Burning Legion still haunt it. Kalimdor faces new trials, while Stormwind needs compassionate healers and leaders to rebuild and protect its people.

faq.q: What should I do after reading the letter?
aliases: where do i take the letter
faq.answer: Carry the letter into Northshire Abbey and speak with Priestess Anetta. She will accept your pledge to the Light and train you in new priestly disciplines as your journey unfolds.

angles.text: As a priest, this missive recognizes you as an instrument of the Holy Light and binds you to Northshire Abbey’s trainers.
As a human, you carry on Northshire Valley’s tradition of holy duty, practiced there since before the First War.
